items.title: Fair Isaac (FICO) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Mortgage Rule Changes Stir Analyst Debate
items.summary: Fair Isaac’s fair value estimate has been revised from US$1,512.25 to US$1,440.16, signalling a modest reset in the price target investors may be anchoring to. This change reflects fresh analyst work that weighs regulatory scrutiny, competition from VantageScore and mortgage share questions against the Direct Licensing Program, government sponsored entity decisions and the software business. As you read on, you will see how this evolving narrative is shaping the way investors follow Fair...

items.title: Here's How Affirm's AI Upgrade Could Strengthen Credit Underwriting
items.summary: AFRM's new AI model uses 14 years of data to expand credit approvals, boost completed purchases and improve early loan performance.

items.title: 2 Cash-Producing Stocks to Own for Decades and 1 That Underwhelm
items.summary: Generating cash is essential for any business, but not all cash-rich companies are great investments. Some produce plenty of cash but fail to allocate it effectively, leading to missed opportunities.

items.title: Autodesk Or Fair Isaac: Which One Earns Its Growth Without Buying It?
items.summary: If you own Autodesk (ADSK) or Fair Isaac (FICO), you own the same idea: software that customers keep paying more for. Fair Isaac grows by charging more for a score it already owns. Autodesk now grows partly by buying a business it did not have. Both raised guidance, and that fork makes the two raises different kinds of news.

items.title: Is Fair Isaac Stock Underperforming the Dow?
items.summary: Despite a challenging year for the stock, Fair Isaac may still have room to rebound, with Wall Street maintaining a moderately optimistic view of its growth prospects.

items.title: 3 Services Stocks with Competitive Advantages
items.summary: Business services providers thrive by solving complex operational challenges for their clients, allowing them to focus on their secret sauce. Furthermore, the demand for their offerings is rising as more clients outsource non-core functions, a trend that has enabled the industry to return 21.4% over the past six months. At the same time, the S&P 500 was up 12.7%.

items.title: AI Agents Are About to Start Spending Your Money. 5 Stocks Sitting in the Line of Fire.
items.summary: AI agents can already pick your next purchase, but they still can't pull the trigger without your permission. Five companies are quietly building the infrastructure that changes that, and they are not all the obvious names.

items.title: 3 Quality Compounders Worth Your Attention
items.summary: Quality compounders are flywheels. Said differently, they’re businesses that generate heaps of profits and consistently reinvest them to produce even more profits. Rinse and repeat.
